english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for throwing something.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for physically throwing something, including throwing something away.
Use this for a light throw, including flipping a coin to decide something.

examples.english: When I got angry, I cast the pillow onto the floor.
examples.traditional: 我一嬲就掟咗個枕頭落地下。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 nau1 zau6 deng3 zo2 go3 zam2 tau4 lok6 dei6 haa6

examples.english: Don't pitch the ball around carelessly; someone could get hurt.
examples.traditional: 唔好亂咁掟個波，會整親人㗎。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam3 deng3 go3 bo1 wui5 zing2 can1 jan4 gaa3

examples.english: We'll toss a coin to decide who goes first.
examples.traditional: 我哋掟個銀仔決定邊個先。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deng3 go3 ngan4 zai2 kyut3 ding6 bin1 go3 sin1
